title: Seagrove Beach "Liberty By the Sea" 68 Chelsea Loop Road
h1: Seagrove Beach "Liberty By the Sea" 68 Chelsea Loop Road
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Located 2nd row from the beach- Stunning Gulf and beach views - Professionally decorated - Renovated Kitchen and Primary Bathrooms- 4 adult bikes- 2 Community Pools- Spectacular Outdoor Space - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Liberty by the Sea in Seagrove Beach has 4 bedrooms, 4.5 bathrooms, and sleeps 16. Guests will love the stunning Gulf views, generous porches, luxurious finishes, and how close the large community pool is to the home. The home is steps away from turquoise waters of the Gulf. Entry to guest spaces is on the second floor. Guests may choose between a primary bedroom, two guest bedrooms, or a bunk area. The primary bedroom has a king bed and private bathroom with a walk-in shower. A guest bedroom has a king bed, private access to a large porch with Gulf views, and a bathroom with shower. A third guest bedroom has a queen-over-queen bunk bed and private bathroom with a shower/tub combo. A large, open bunk area opens onto a porch with Gulf views and has 3 twin-over-twin bunk beds, a foosball table, and access to a laundry room.The kitchen and main living spaces are on the third floor to take full advantage of the spectacular Gulf views. Guests can see the Gulf from both the living room and the renovated kitchen, where premium appliances and a dine-in counter with seating for 3 provide ample space for meal prep. An expansive living area feels even more prominent thanks to a vaulted ceiling finished in natural wood. Glass doors from the living room open onto a porch with an outdoor dining table with seating for 6 and a premium gas grill. Inside, a round dining table with seating for 8 is located opposite the kitchen and leads to a guest bedroom with a king bed and a bathroom with a walk-in shower.On the first floor, enjoy an enclosed space protected from the weather featuring a foosball table, ping pong table, and dining table. Guests will enjoy exploring all that Seagrove Beach has to offer on 4 included adult bikes. With beach and pool access, spectacular Gulf views, and multiple porches, Liberty by the Sea will book quickly, reserve today.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (SLEEPS 16):SECOND FLOOR- Primary Bedroom: King bed, Private Bathroom with Walk-in Shower- Guest Bedroom: King bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen-over-Queen Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Bunk Area: Three Twin-over-Twin Bunk BedsTHIRD FLOOR- Second Primary Bedroom: King bed, Private Bathroom with Walk-in Shower- Half Bathroom: Toilet OnlyHOA prohibits Low-Speed Vehicle rentals in Summer's Edge.
